review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The one-change overlay replaces a conditional check `if proposal.context_binding_mode != "snapshot_bound":` with `if False:`. The original condition evaluates to True whenever the context_binding_mode is anything other than "snapshot_bound", triggering the associated branch logic. The replacement `if False:` unconditionally suppresses that branch entirely, meaning the branch body will never execute regardless of the actual value of `proposal.context_binding_mode`. For any input where `context_binding_mode` differs from "snapshot_bound"`, the original code would execute the branch body while the mutated code would not, producing an observable behavioral difference in the governed system's output or state.
